title: Vukmir Janković, the Pope's admiral in the crusade, dies at sea
Prince Yūsuf ibn Saʿd, son of the first Emperor and great-uncle of the princes, dies of old age at sixty-three, after thirty years in the dīwān

The Emperor's turn to the sea: all seven arsenals are finished, eight Andalusī war galleys have joined the fifty caravels of the fleet, and the realm's temper has swung far from the land toward the sea

landVsNaval.note: negative is land, positive is sea
